name: x-context
description: MCP server exposing your own X posts (with metrics) as writing context for Claude agents. Read-only.
author: Alpha Luppi <alphaluppi@gmail.com>

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --format=esm --outfile=dist/server.mjs --minify --legal-comments=none --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun test && bun run pack:mcpb
